zh.title: Embraer 公佈荷蘭產業合作進度 籌備 C-390 運輸機隊支援
zh.summary: Embraer 在鹿特丹公佈荷蘭合作案進度，包括為 C-390 建立在地維修與後勤能力。
body: Embraer 於11月19日在荷蘭鹿特丹的 NEDS 展會公佈產業合作進度。公司表示，已與荷蘭軍事生產主管機關及當地企業、研究機構推動多項合作，並正為荷蘭 C-390 運輸機隊的長期運作做準備。
C-390 支援準備涵蓋培養在地維修、整合後勤、構型管理與訓練能力。Embraer 表示，另有合作專案著眼於改善飛機維修作業與可用性。
荷蘭方面指出，相關合作建立在採購 C-390 的產業參與安排上。這次公告說明合作與機隊支援準備的進度，未公佈新的採購數量或交付日期。

en.title: Embraer reports Dutch industrial cooperation progress and C-390 support preparations
en.summary: The manufacturer is developing local maintenance, logistics and training capabilities for the Dutch C-390 fleet.
body: Embraer reported progress on its Dutch industrial participation programme at NEDS in Rotterdam on November 19. It said several projects with Dutch industry, research institutions and the country’s military production authority are under way.

Preparations for the long-term operation of the Dutch C-390 Millennium fleet include developing local expertise in maintenance, integrated logistics, configuration management and training. Other projects focus on improving aircraft maintenance and availability.

The Dutch military production commissioner linked the collaboration to the C-390 acquisition. The announcement outlined industrial cooperation and support preparations, without giving a new procurement quantity or delivery date.

facts.claim: Embraer outlined Dutch industrial participation projects at NEDS in Rotterdam.
Local capabilities are being developed for Dutch C-390 fleet sustainment.
The support preparations include maintenance, logistics, configuration management and training.

zh.title: 宿霧太平洋航空接收今年第六架新機 A320neo 自天津飛抵馬尼拉
zh.summary: 宿霧太平洋航空於11月19日接收一架 A320neo，為今年第四架同型新機。
body: 菲律賓宿霧太平洋航空11月19日接收一架空中巴士 A320neo。據 AeroTime 報導，客機從空中巴士天津總裝廠飛往馬尼拉，是該公司今年接收的第六架新機，也是今年第四架 A320neo。
這次交付是在11月8日接收一架 A321neo 之後。先前抵達的 A321neo 為公司成立30週年的紀念彩繪機。
宿霧太平洋航空表示，新機有助於因應耶誕與年末旅遊旺季的旅運需求。據報導，公司預計今年共接收七架空中巴士 neo 系列客機。

en.title: Cebu Pacific takes delivery of its sixth aircraft of 2026, an Airbus A320neo
en.summary: The A320neo flew from Airbus’s Tianjin assembly facility to Manila ahead of the holiday travel season.
body: Cebu Pacific took delivery of an Airbus A320neo on November 19. The aircraft flew from Airbus’s Tianjin final assembly facility to Manila, AeroTime reported. It was the carrier’s sixth new aircraft of the year and its fourth A320neo delivery in 2026.
It follows the arrival of an A321neo on November 8, which carried a special livery marking the Philippine airline’s 30th anniversary.
Cebu Pacific said the additional aircraft will help it accommodate demand during the peak Christmas travel season. The carrier expects to receive seven Airbus neo family aircraft during 2026.

facts.claim: The A320neo delivered on November 19 flew to Manila from Tianjin.
It is the sixth new aircraft and fourth A320neo delivered to Cebu Pacific in 2026.
Cebu Pacific expects seven neo aircraft deliveries in 2026.

zh.title: Ascendance 展出全尺寸 ATEA 混合電力垂直起降航空器原型
zh.summary: 法國 Ascendance 於土魯斯附近展出 ATEA，首飛仍須等候主管機關許可。
body: 法國新創公司 Ascendance 於11月19日在土魯斯附近的米雷－萊爾姆飛行場公開展示全尺寸 ATEA 原型機。這款航空器採混合電力設計，規劃具備垂直起降能力，目前仍在準備飛行測試。
據 AeroTime 報導，Ascendance 已於今年2月公佈示範機機體完工，後續由團隊整合推進、航電及飛控系統。公司先前已選定 Safran 的 ENGINeUS 電動馬達供飛行原型機使用。
AeroTime 引述公司方面指出，原型機首飛有望於2027年初進行，前提是取得主管機關許可。公司尚未公佈首飛的確切日期。

en.title: Ascendance unveils full-scale ATEA hybrid-electric VTOL aircraft prototype
en.summary: The French developer presented the ATEA near Toulouse and is awaiting approval for its flight-test campaign.
body: French developer Ascendance unveiled its full-scale ATEA prototype on November 19 at Muret-Lherm airfield near Toulouse, AeroTime reported. The hybrid-electric aircraft is designed for vertical takeoff and landing, and the company is preparing for flight testing.

Ascendance announced completion of the demonstrator airframe in February, paving the way for propulsion, avionics and flight-control integration. It previously selected Safran’s ENGINeUS electric motor for the flying prototype.
AeroTime reported that Ascendance expects a first flight in early 2027, subject to approval from the aviation authority. The company has not announced a specific date.

facts.claim: Ascendance unveiled the full-scale ATEA prototype at Muret-Lherm on November 19.
The company announced completion of the demonstrator airframe in February 2026.
The initial flight is expected in early 2027 subject to regulatory approval.

zh.title: CoolFly Aircraft稱Dream ST電動飛行器已準備交付
zh.summary: CoolFly Aircraft稱單人座Dream ST電動垂直起降機已準備交付。
body: CoolFly Aircraft表示，其Dream ST個人電動垂直起降（eVTOL）飛行器已準備交付。該機採單人開放式座艙設計，瞄準超輕型航空器市場。
Dream ST曾在法國進行載人飛行。該公司表示，該機也於10月在馬爾地夫完成一次載人跨島飛行。
CoolFly Aircraft提供的性能資料指出，Dream ST最大酬載為95公斤；搭載70公斤飛行員時，飛行時間為16分鐘。

en.title: CoolFly Aircraft Says Dream ST Electric Aircraft Is Ready for Delivery
en.summary: CoolFly Aircraft says its single-seat Dream ST electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft is ready for delivery.
body: CoolFly Aircraft says its seated Dream ST personal electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft is ready for delivery. The single-seat model has an open cockpit and is aimed at the ultralight aircraft market.
Dream ST has made crewed flights in France. The company also said the aircraft completed a crewed island-to-island flight in the Maldives in October.
CoolFly puts Dream ST’s maximum payload at 95 kilograms. Its stated flight time is 16 minutes with a pilot weighing 70 kilograms.

zh.title: 印度航空檢討成本 研議與印度快運航空加強合作
zh.summary: 印度航空面臨全年虧損逾2,200億盧比的壓力，董事會已研究多項降低成本的方案。
body: 中央社引述印度媒體報導，截至2026年3月底的財政年度，印度航空虧損逾2,200億印度盧比。董事會已研究降低成本的方案，包括與旗下低成本業者印度快運航空加強合作。
印度新聞信託社指出，燃油價格上漲推高營運成本，巴基斯坦空域限制影響國際航班，供應鏈問題也拖慢機隊擴張和更新。這些壓力出現在印度航空試圖改善服務及強化航網之際。
據中央社報導，公司另組成跨部門團隊研議節省成本。加強兩家航空公司合作仍屬評估中的方案，報導未指出已決定合併或調整航線。

en.title: Air India reviews costs and considers closer cooperation with Air India Express
en.summary: The carrier is weighing cost reductions after its fiscal 2026 loss exceeded 220 billion rupees.
body: Air India is reviewing ways to cut costs after losses exceeded 220 billion rupees in the financial year ended March 2026, Taiwan’s Central News Agency reported, citing Indian media. Its board has considered closer cooperation with low-cost subsidiary Air India Express.

The Press Trust of India attributed the pressure to rising fuel costs, Pakistani airspace restrictions affecting international operations and supply constraints that slowed fleet expansion and renewal.

Central News Agency reported that the company also put together a cross-functional team to identify savings. Closer cooperation remains under consideration, with no merger decision or route changes reported.

facts.claim: Air India recorded losses of more than 220 billion rupees in fiscal 2026.
The company has considered closer cooperation with Air India Express and formed a team to identify cost savings.
Higher fuel prices, Pakistani airspace restrictions and supply issues weighed on operations.

zh.title: Embraer 與 Envoy Air 延長 E-Jet 客機重度維修協議
zh.summary: Embraer 將在美國兩處設施繼續為 Envoy Air 提供補充重度維修，並增加專屬維修產能。
body: Embraer 與美國區域航空公司 Envoy Air 宣佈延長 E-Jet 重度維修合約。補充維修作業將繼續由喬治亞州梅肯與德州沃斯堡的設施承接，擴大後的協議將增加專門提供給 Envoy 的維修產能。
Envoy 是美國航空集團全資子公司。Embraer 表示，Envoy 目前營運189架 E-Jet，並持續接收新機，機隊規模承諾至少達214架。
Embraer 同時在沃斯堡的佩羅菲爾德聯盟機場投資約7,000萬美元興建新維修設施，預計2027年啟用。原廠估計，該設施完工後，可使其在美國的 E-Jet 維修服務產能增加逾五成。

en.title: Embraer and Envoy Air extend heavy maintenance agreement for E-Jet aircraft
en.summary: Embraer will continue supplemental heavy maintenance at two US sites and allocate more capacity to Envoy.
body: Embraer and Envoy Air have extended their US heavy maintenance agreement for E-Jets. Supplemental work will continue in Macon, Georgia, and Fort Worth, Texas, with the expanded deal giving Envoy more dedicated maintenance capacity.
Envoy, an American Airlines Group subsidiary, operates 189 E-Jets and continues taking deliveries toward a minimum fleet commitment of 214 aircraft, according to Embraer.

Separately, Embraer is investing about $70 million in a commercial maintenance facility at Perot Field Alliance Airport (AIA) in Fort Worth. It expects the facility to open in 2027 and expand its US E-Jet service capacity by more than half.

facts.claim: Embraer and Envoy extended heavy maintenance in Macon and Fort Worth.
Envoy operates 189 E-Jets with a minimum fleet commitment of 214.
Embraer expects its new Fort Worth facility to enter service in 2027.

en.title: United Airlines to be world's largest carrier for one day as Thanksgiving cuts US flights 44%
en.summary: OAG data shows United will operate 3,102 movements to 335 airports on Thanksgiving Day, November 26, overtaking American Airlines for a single day as US schedules shrink 44% from the prior Thursday.
body: Thanksgiving is nearly here, and the US schedule will shrink sharply. OAG data shows 14,993 scheduled passenger services on November 26, down 44% from the prior Thursday, with 11,568 flights removed. Domestic activity falls 47%, against an 11% reduction internationally.

American Airlines, ordinarily the world's largest carrier by aircraft movements, will see activity fall 57% on the day to 3,007 movements across 322 airports, dropping it to third globally. United Airlines, down a comparatively modest 44%, will operate 3,102 movements to 335 airports, making it the world's largest airline for one day only. Houston Intercontinental, with 725 movements, overtakes Chicago O'Hare (ORD) and Denver as United's most-served hub.

The airport ranking will also change: Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport (CAN) will be the world's busiest airport on November 26 with 1,516 movements, ahead of O'Hare, Atlanta, Dallas/Fort Worth, Denver and Charlotte, while O'Hare returns to the top spot on November 27. Allegiant cuts deepest among the top 20 US carriers, down 68% to 154 movements, and Breeze falls 59% to 126.

zh.title: 感恩節航班大減44%：美聯航單日3,102架次暫居全球最大航空公司
zh.summary: 受感恩節航班縮減影響，美聯航11月26日預計飛航3,102架次、覆蓋335座機場，單日超越美航成為全球最大航空公司；全美當日航班較前一週減少44%。
body: 感恩節將至，美國航空市場將出現大幅縮減。根據OAG數據，11月26日全美預計僅有14,993班客運航班，較前一個週四減少44%，共取消11,568班航班；國內線減幅達47%，國際線僅減少11%。
平日以飛機起降架次計全球最大的美航，當日航班較前一週大減57%，預計僅飛航3,007架次、覆蓋322座機場，排名跌至全球第3。美聯航僅減少44%，預計飛航3,102架次、覆蓋335座機場，單日登頂全球第1；美聯航當日最繁忙樞紐為休士頓洲際機場，預計725架次。
同日全球最繁忙機場也將易主：廣州白雲國際機場預計1,516架次起降，超越歐海爾、亞特蘭大、達拉斯／沃斯堡、丹佛與夏洛特，成為當日全球第1；歐海爾機場將於11月27日重回榜首。廉航方面，忠實航空航班大減68%，僅剩154架次；微風航空減少59%，僅126架次。
